name: cheapllm.shop
description: Single-model API with a permanent hourly free allowance and no card.
overview: cheapllm.shop serves one model, DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 1017, through OpenAI, Anthropic Messages and Responses formats so existing SDKs work by changing the base URL. During its beta every account is unmetered; when the beta closes the vendor promises a permanent free tier of at least 5,000 input and 1,000 output tokens per hour per account with no card, with usage beyond that billed at $0.005 per million input tokens. One request runs at a time per account.
